lessons.title: Practice If-Else Statements
lessons.description: C++ uses if, else if, and else. Implement is_even(int n) returning true if n is divisible by 2. The test checks that is_even(4) equals true; is_even(7) equals false.
learning_objectives: Mesa potters recount crates before dawn, and use if-else and modulo operator in C.

exercises.explanation: score >= 30 chooses yes at the boundary.

lessons.title: Practice Logical Operators
lessons.description: C++ uses && for AND, || for OR, and ! for NOT. Implement can_drive(bool has_license, bool is_sober), which is true only when the driver holds a licence and is sober. The test checks that can_drive(true, true) equals true; can_drive(true, false) equals false.
learning_objectives: Orchard potters recount crates before dawn, and use logical AND and OR in C.

tests.name: test_can_drive
tests.test_code:
assert(can_drive(true, true) == true);
assert(can_drive(true, false) == false);
